posthoc_provenance.h04_characterization: H04's broad preregistered pullback-continuation mechanism did not satisfy its full promotion contract. Local effects, including a moderate-depth residual, existed but did not form the required robust depth neighborhood and remain POSTHOC_UNTESTED.
posthoc_provenance.h04_primary_surface: mixed; some local cells satisfied effect/control thresholds; no required broad robust depth neighborhood
posthoc_provenance.retained_L_surface_reason: frozen H04 lookback family; not because L=480/960 moderate cells looked attractive

chronology.decision_times: UTC 15-minute boundaries, inherited from H04, not retuned
chronology.last_legal_T_rule: T + H < 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z on the 15m grid; close(T+H) at exactly 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z is illegal; no truncation

novelty_boundary.h04_tested_object: established-trend plus material counter-trend pullback continuation across a three-band depth neighborhood
novelty_boundary.b2_04_tested_object: intra-pullback recovery from the deepest adverse excursion inside already-qualified moderate-depth H04 events
novelty_boundary.b2_03_tested_object: shape of an impulse generating a displacement

structural_property.name: RECOVERY_FRACTION

formulas.DIRECTION: d = +1 if TREND_RET_L>0 else -1 if TREND_RET_L<0; exact zero excluded
formulas.FINAL_DEPTH: ADVERSE_{t=T} which equals H04 PULLBACK_DEPTH(T) exactly
formulas.MAX_ADVERSE: max(ADVERSE_j for t_j in {T-45m, T-30m, T-15m, T})

structural_property.undefined_policy: nonfinite ADVERSE path, MAX_ADVERSE<=0, FINAL_DEPTH>MAX_ADVERSE, or nonfinite RECOVERY_FRACTION does not delete the constructed event and does not change the refractory winner; the H-specific score record is UNAVAILABLE_FOR_DECISION for both candidate and baseline

inputs: exact 1m closes required for TREND_RET_L and PULLBACK_DEPTH

REFRACTORY.scope: within each L on the constructed moderate stream; earliest T wins

event_construction.established_trend: TREND_PCTL_L(T) >= 0.80 using H04 midrank of ABS_TREND_L on the same 15m grid, preceding 30 calendar days, current T excluded
event_construction.refractory_scope: within each L on the constructed moderate stream; keep earliest; identical to H04 L x moderate-band refractory; recovery, target, and H are not used
event_construction.unavailable_recovery_policy: constructed event remains; refractory winner unchanged; H-specific score record becomes UNAVAILABLE_FOR_DECISION for both candidate and baseline
event_construction.warmup_records: constructible as causal reference/training material only; never scored

canonical_score_serialization.used_for: horizon evaluation; baseline and candidate share this identity

canonical_serialization.L_representation: plain base-10 integer minutes, no leading zero
canonical_serialization.direction_representation: exactly UP or DOWN, uppercase ASCII
canonical_serialization.timestamp_representation: integer UTC epoch milliseconds, no scientific notation
canonical_serialization.T_ms_definition: decision time T as integer UTC epoch milliseconds
canonical_serialization.H_representation: plain base-10 integer minutes, no leading zero

target.scale_reference: median absolute H-horizon close return at prior canonical UTC 15-minute grid points over the preceding 30 calendar days, using only reference points whose own H-horizon outcome is fully known by current T (ref_t+H<=T)
target.scale_denominator_requirements: finite, positive, known by T; no winsorization, no future-informed floor, no sign flip, no whole-sample statistic
target.horizon_alignment: close(T+H) is the close of the complete 15m bar ending at T+H; still-forming bar never used

directional_prior.statement: higher RECOVERY_FRACTION corresponds to stronger subsequent trend-direction continuation
directional_prior.expected_structure_ordering: HIGH recovery residual > LOW recovery residual

structure_ordering_only.reference_population: prior constructed B2-04 moderate events, same L, finite RECOVERY_FRACTION, reference_T < current T, current event excluded, UP/DOWN pooled because RECOVERY_FRACTION is already trend-normalized

baseline_context.actual_depth_control: untransformed FINAL_DEPTH entered as a numeric regressor in the same OLS family as the candidate
baseline_context.why_not_depth_half: RECOVERY_FRACTION = 1 - FINAL_DEPTH/MAX_ADVERSE, so a two-bin depth control would leave residual within-bin depth that recovery could proxy; continuous FINAL_DEPTH is the actual-depth control

forecast.fit_equation_candidate: Y_H = a + b * FINAL_DEPTH + c * RECOVERY_FRACTION
forecast.joint_unavailability: if either candidate or baseline cannot produce a valid prediction, the scored record is unavailable for both

support_feasibility.source: docs/research/H04_DEV_SUMMARY.md public post-refractory moderate counts only; no market parquet
support_feasibility.why_not_b2_03_90d_80_40: H04 moderate N is far smaller than B2-03 constructed events; 90d occupancy at L=960 is about 45 events before the direction split, too tight for a 3-parameter OLS plus MAE evaluation
support_feasibility.why_365d_ols_continuous_depth: sample-size feasibility and an actual-depth control that is not a within-band half; not chosen from return performance
support_feasibility.why_min_30: shared (L, DIRECTION) training set must support 3 OLS parameters without a pseudoinverse; L=960 365d per-direction occupancy is about 90

controls.permutation_scope: per-scored-event causal 365d training set with training_T+H<=current_T
controls.permutation_target: historical training RECOVERY_FRACTION values only; historical Y fixed; historical FINAL_DEPTH fixed; evaluation event's own RECOVERY_FRACTION fixed
controls.permutation_ordering: sort each (L, DIRECTION) training pool by CANONICAL_SCORE_RECORD_ID before RNG, then permute

seed_derivation_primitive.description: pipe-join str(part) for each ordered part in the seed_derivation sequence, UTF-8 encode, SHA-256, take the first 16 hex digits as an integer

baseline_stratum_id_serialization.L_representation: plain base-10 integer, no leading zero
baseline_stratum_id_serialization.direction_representation: exactly UP or DOWN, uppercase ASCII

controls.current_T_representation: T_ms: integer UTC epoch milliseconds, identical representation to event_identity.canonical_serialization.timestamp_representation
controls.bootstrap_week_id: ISO week-numbering year * 100 + ISO week of event T (datetime.isocalendar() year and week in UTC; not the Gregorian calendar year)
controls.bootstrap_resample: resample whole UTC weeks with replacement; concatenate events in canonical-id order within each drawn week; empty resample is nonfinite and cannot produce a passing lower bound
controls.bootstrap_interval: percentiles 2.5 and 97.5 of pooled mean AE_IMPROVEMENT

bootstrap_positive.pooled_condition: 95% UTC-week block-bootstrap lower bound for mean AE improvement > 0

placebo_separation.placebo_q95_definition: 95th percentile of the frozen 100 causal permutation replicates (controls.permutation_replicates)

structure_ordering.definition: BASE_RESIDUAL = Y_H - BASE_PRED; STRUCTURE_SEPARATION(subset) = median(BASE_RESIDUAL | RECOVERY_STATE=HIGH, subset) - median(BASE_RESIDUAL | RECOVERY_STATE=LOW, subset)

promotion_gate_contract.horizon_robustness: for one L, at least two adjacent horizons in [15,30,60,120,240] (adjacent pairs 15/30, 30/60, 60/120, 120/240) pass all five per-cell gates, including the anti_rescue_side_symmetry subconditions
promotion_gate_contract.parameter_robustness: the exact same adjacent-H pair also passes all five per-cell gates for at least one other L; no single L may promote alone; historically attractive H04 L values may not promote alone
promotion_gate_contract.year_stability: every promotion-neighborhood cell (the adjacent-H pair at both promoting L values) has positive pooled mean AE improvement in >=4/5 development years (2020,2021,2022,2023,2024); no year exclusions

forbidden_after_failure: narrow depth around an attractive result

durable_retention_integration.execution_host_preflight: verify authenticated isolated evidence transport (GIT_ASKPASS / no global insteadOf inside evidence git) BEFORE one-shot authorization; B2-03 PRE_CLAIM_OPERATIONAL_ABORT is operational precedent only and does not change B2-04 statistics
